about: measure contests of 2022 in Rhode Island, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2022 by Individual State, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/UYQIEP, version 5.0
medsl.note: precinct returns compiled by MEDSL from each state's official sources (named per state in its README); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files RI-cleaned.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

source.name: Rhode Island General Assembly, Office of Law Revision: Public Laws 2022 ch. 231 (2022-H 7123 Sub A as amended), Article 5 'Relating to Capital Development Program' (the act that put the November 8, 2022 bond questions on the ballot). The Secretary of State's voter handbook was refused (Cloudflare challenge).

ballot_text.source_title: Article 5, Section 1, project (3): Green Economy Bonds $50,000,000
ballot_text.type_quote: Shall the action of the general assembly, by an act passed at the January 2022 session, authorizing the issuance of bonds, refunding bonds, and temporary notes of the State of Rhode Island

fact.quote: (3) Green Economy Bonds $50,000,000 Approval of this question will allow the State of Rhode Island to issue general obligation bonds
fact.why: The act submits to the people a proposition authorizing the issuance of bonds, refunding bonds, and temporary notes of the State of Rhode Island and lists this as project (3), $50,000,000; its Section 3 sets the share for each project. Matched to our question by title and amount.

source.name: Rhode Island General Assembly, Office of Law Revision: Public Laws 2022 ch. 231 (2022-H 7123 Sub A as amended), Article 5 'Relating to Capital Development Program' (the act that put the November 8, 2022 bond questions on the ballot). The Secretary of State's voter handbook was refused (Cloudflare challenge).

fact.note: the question is a project of the proposition the act puts to the people; the act's own s.3 sets the share (data/measure/thresholds.json, the act's rule)

threshold.rule: a majority of the people voting on the proposition, project by project
threshold.quote: If a majority of the People voting on the proposition in Section 1 hereof shall vote to approve any project stated therein, said project shall be deemed to be approved by the People.
threshold.read_in: step (a), with the ballot texts (data/measure/ballot-texts.json): the act that puts a question on the ballot is the law that governs it (the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 14:21)
threshold.matched: by the type the source's title states (bond); the ballot text shows it is a project of the proposition put to the people by R.I. P.L. 2022, ch. 231 [stated] (data/measure/ballot-texts.json)

p.under: the model's own (D3-v1.1), like past measures
p.note: this route's back-test of statewide measures shows more near-even finishes than it forecast (11 against 6.8 within 1 point of ½, and 10 against 6.2 within 20,000 votes, 2018 to 2024), so p may be low

ballot_text.source_title: Article 5, Section 1, project (1): University of Rhode Island Narragansett Bay Campus $100,000,000
ballot_text.type_quote: Shall the action of the general assembly, by an act passed at the January 2022 session, authorizing the issuance of bonds, refunding bonds, and temporary notes of the State of Rhode Island

fact.quote: (1) University of Rhode Island Narragansett Bay Campus $100,000,000 Provides one hundred million dollars ($100,000,000) to fund repairs
fact.why: The act submits to the people a proposition authorizing 'the issuance of bonds, refunding bonds, and temporary notes of the State of Rhode Island' and lists this as project (1), $100,000,000. Section 3 of the act says 'If a majority of the People voting on the proposition in Section 1 hereof shall vote to approve any project stated therein, said project shall be deemed to be approved by the People'. Matched to our question by title and amount. The same act's proposition has a third project (Green Economy Bonds $50,000,000) not in our list.
